# contracts commands

Every `contracts` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `contracts:list`

List service contracts (interfaces) and their active implementation. Use when debugging which class is bound to an interface.

```bash
bin/semitexa contracts:list
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |
